magga：'path'．1．For the 4 supermundane paths （lokuttara-magga），s．ariya-puggala - 2．The Eightfold Path （aṭṭhaṅgika-magga） is the path leading to the extinction of suffering，i．e．the last of the 4 Noble Truths （sacca，q．v．），namely：

Wisdom （paññā） III．

1．Right view （sammā-diṭṭhi）

2．Right thought （sammā-saṅkappa）

Morality （sīla） I．

3．Right speech （sammā-vācā）

4．Right bodily action （sammā-kammanta）

5．Right livelihood （sammā-ājīva）

Concentration （samādhi） II．

6．Right effort （sammā-vāyāma）

7．Right mindfulness （sammā-sati）

8．Right concentration （sammā-samādhi）

1．Right view or right understanding （sammā-diṭṭhi） is the understanding of the 4 Noble Truths about the universality of suffering （unsatisfactoriness），of its origin，its cessation，and the path leading to that cessation．- See the Discourse on 'Right Understanding' （M．9，tr．and Com．in 'R．Und．'）．

2．Right thought （sammā-saṅkappa）：thoughts free from sensuous desire，from ill-will，and cruelty．

3．Right speech （sammā-vācā）：abstaining from lying，tale-bearing，harsh language，and foolish babble．

4 Right bodily action （sammā-kammanta）：abstaining from killing，stealing，and unlawful sexual intercourse．

5．Right livelihood （sammā-ājīva）：abstaining from a livelihood that brings harm to other beings，such as trading in arms，in living beings，intoxicating drinks，poison； slaughtering，fishing，soldiering，deceit，treachery soothsaying，trickery，usury，etc．

6．Right effort （sammā-vāyāma）：the effort of avoiding or overcoming evil and unwholesome things，and of developing and maintaining wholesome things （s．padhāna）．

7．Right mindfulness （sammā-sati）：mindfulness and awareness in contemplating body，feelings，mind，and mind-objects （s．sati，Satipaṭṭhāna）．

8．Right concentration （sammā-samādhi）：concentration of mind associated with wholesome （kusala） consciousness，which eventually may reach the absorptions （jhāna，q．v．）．Cf．samādhi．

There are to be distinguished 2 kinds of concentration，mundane （lokiya） and supermundane （lokuttara） concentration．The latter is associated with those states of consciousness known as the 4 supermundane paths and fruitions （s．ariya-puggala）．As it is said in M．117：

＂I tell you，o monks，there are 2 kinds of right view：the understanding that it is good to give alms and offerings，that both good and evil actions will bear fruit and will be followed by results．．．．This，o monks，is a view which，though still subject to the cankers，is meritorious，yields worldly fruits，and brings good results．But whatever there is of wisdom，of penetration，of right view conjoined with the path - the holy path being pursued，this is called the supermundane right view （lokuttara-sammā-diṭṭhi），which is not of the world，but which is supermundane and conjoined with the path．＂

In a similar way the remaining links of the path are to be understood．

As many of those who have written about the Eightfold Path have misunderstood its true nature，it is therefore appropriate to add here a few elucidating remarks about it，as this path is fundamental for the understanding and practice of the Buddha's ．teaching．

First of all，the figurative expression 'path' should not be interpreted to mean that one has to advance step by step in the sequence of the enumeration until，after successively passing through all the eight stages，one finally may reach one's destination，Nibbāna．If this really were the case，one should have realized，first of all，right view and penetration of the truth，even before one could hope to proceed to the next steps，right thought and right speech； and each preceding stage would be the indispensable foundation and condition for each succeeding stage．In reality，however，the links 3-5 constituting moral training （sīla），are the first 3 links to be cultivated，then the links 6-8 constituting mental training （samādhi），and at last right view，etc．constituting wisdom （paññā）．

It is，however，true that a really unshakable and safe foundation to the path is provided only by right view which，starting from the tiniest germ of faith and knowledge，gradually，step by step，develops into penetrating insight （vipassanā） and thus forms the immediate condition for the entrance into the 4 supermundane paths and fruits of holiness，and for the realization of Nibbāna．Only with regard to this highest form of supermundane insight，may we indeed say that all the remaining links of the path are nothing but the outcome and the accompaniments of right view．

Regarding the mundane （lokiya） eightfold path，however，its links may arise without the first link，right view．

Here it must also be emphasized that the links of the path not only do not arise one after the other，as already indicated，but also that they，at least in part，arise simultaneously as inseparably associated mental factors in one and the same state of consciousness．Thus，for instance，under all circumstances at least 4 links are inseparably bound up with any kammically wholesome consciousness，namely 2，6，7 and 8，i．e．right thought，right effort，right mindfulness and right concentration （M．117），so that as soon as any one of these links arises，the three others also do so．On the other hand，right view is not necessarily present in every wholesome state of consciousness．

Magga is one of the 24 conditions （s．paccaya 18）．

အကျိုးပေးမြဲသော အရိယာမဂ်။

magganta： magganta（ti）
မဂ္ဂန္တ（တိ）

[မဂ္ဂ+အန္တ]
K:
magganta：မဂ္ဂန္တ（တိ）
[မဂ္ဂ+အန္တ]
ရှာမှီး-ရှာဖွေ-သော၊ သူ။

maggapaccaya.p: [Magga+paccaya] (pu) CL=8 Paccaññaḥ that is to be Mag, Magga paccaññaḥ. Magga - see.
a: မဂ္ဂပစ္စယ(ပု)
မဂ်ဖြစ်သော ပစ္စည်း၊ မဂ္ဂပစ္စည်း။ မဂ္ဂ-ကြည့်။

B:
maggapaccaya： maggapaccaya（pu）
မဂ္ဂပစ္စယ（ပု）
[magga+paccaya]
[မဂ္ဂ+ပစ္စယ]
K:
maggapaccaya：မဂ္ဂပစ္စယ（ပု）
[မဂ္ဂ+ပစ္စယ]
မဂ်ဖြစ်သော ပစ္စည်း၊ မဂ္ဂပစ္စည်း။ မဂ္ဂ-ကြည့်။

maggaparibbaya.p: [Magga+paribbaya] (pu) CL=8 ration for journey.  Travel expenses.
a: မဂ္ဂပရိဗ္ဗယ(ပု)
လမ်းခရီးရိက္ခာ၊ လမ်းစရိတ်။

B:
maggaparibbaya： maggaparibbaya（pu）
မဂ္ဂပရိဗ္ဗယ（ပု）
[magga+paribbaya]
[မဂ္ဂ+ပရိဗ္ဗယ]
K:
maggaparibbaya：မဂ္ဂပရိဗ္ဗယ（ပု）
[မဂ္ဂ+ပရိဗ္ဗယ]
လမ်းခရီးရိက္ခာ၊ လမ်းစရိတ်။
R:
maggaparibbaya：မဂ္ဂ-ပရိဗ္ဗယ （ပ）
ခရီးစာရိက္ခာ။

maggapaññā.p: [Magga+paññā] (thī) CL=8 Mag Wisdom,  wisdom which is related to wisdom.  phalapaññā - see.
a: မဂ်ပညာ၊ မဂ်စိတ်-နှင့်ယှဉ်-၌ရှိ-သော ပညာ။ ဖလပညာ-ကြည့်။

B:
maggapaññā： maggapaññā（thī）
မဂ္ဂပညာ（ထီ）
[magga+paññā]
[မဂ္ဂ+ပညာ]
K:
maggapaññā：မဂ္ဂပညာ（ထီ）
[မဂ္ဂ+ပညာ]
မဂ်ပညာ၊ မဂ်စိတ်-နှင့်ယှဉ်-၌ရှိ-သော ပညာ။ ဖလပညာ-ကြည့်။

maggapaññāsati.p: [Magga+paññāsati] (thī) CL=8 Maggapaññā+sati].  wisdom attention that happend in mag (consciousness), the attention which is related with Mag wisdom.
a: မဂ္ဂပညာသတိ(ထီ)
မဂ္ဂပညာ+သတိ] မဂ်စိတ်၌ရှိသော ပညာသတိ၊ မဂ်ပညာနှင့် ယှဉ်သော သတိ။

B:
maggapaññāsati： maggapaññāsati（thī）
မဂ္ဂပညာသတိ（ထီ）
[magga+paññāsati．maggapaññā+sati]
[မဂ္ဂ+ပညာသတိ။ မဂ္ဂပညာ+သတိ]
K:
maggapaññāsati：မဂ္ဂပညာသတိ（ထီ）
[မဂ္ဂ+ပညာသတိ။ မဂ္ဂပညာ+သတိ]
မဂ်စိတ်၌ရှိသော ပညာသတိ၊ မဂ်ပညာနှင့် ယှဉ်သော သတိ။

maggapaṭipāṭi.p: [Magga+paṭipāṭi] (thī) CL=8 The sequence of the Noble Eightfold Path (Ariyāmaga).
a: မဂ္ဂပဋိပါဋိ(ထီ)
အရိယာမဂ်အစဉ်။

B:
maggapaṭipāṭi： maggapaṭipāṭi（thī）
မဂ္ဂပဋိပါဋိ（ထီ）
[magga+paṭipāṭi]
[မဂ္ဂ+ပဋိပါဋိ]
K:
maggapaṭipāṭi：မဂ္ဂပဋိပါဋိ（ထီ）
[မဂ္ဂ+ပဋိပါဋိ]
အရိယာမဂ်အစဉ်။

maggaphala.p:
[Magga+phala] (na) CL=8 (1) Mag, Phiula. (2) Benefits of Mag.

(Phiula means state of fruition on following the Right Path leading to Nirvana).
(Mag means path leading to renunciation of desire in order to attain Nirvana).

B:
maggaphala： maggaphala（na）
မဂ္ဂဖလ（န）
[magga+phala]
[မဂ္ဂ+ဖလ]
K:
maggaphala：မဂ္ဂဖလ（န）
[မဂ္ဂ+ဖလ]
（၁） မဂ်，ဖိုလ်။ （၂） မဂ်၏အကျိုး။
R:
maggaphala：မဂ္ဂ-ဖလ （န）
မဂ်၏အကျိုးဟူသော ဖိုလ်စိတ်။ မဂ်ဖိုလ်။

maggaphalapaṭivedha.p:
[Maggaphala+paṭivedha] (pu) CL=8 Insight into Mag, Phiula.
(Phiula means state of fruition on following the Right Path leading to Nirvana).
(Mag means path leading to renunciation of desire in order to attain Nirvana).
a: မဂ္ဂဖလပဋိဝေဓ(ပု)
[မဂ္ဂဖလ+ပဋိဝေဓ]

B:
maggaphalapaṭivedha： maggaphalapaṭivedha（pu）
မဂ္ဂဖလပဋိဝေဓ（ပု）
[maggaphala+paṭivedha]
[မဂ္ဂဖလ+ပဋိဝေဓ]
K:
maggaphalapaṭivedha：မဂ္ဂဖလပဋိဝေဓ（ပု）
[မဂ္ဂဖလ+ပဋိဝေဓ]
မဂ်，ဖိုလ်ကို ထိုးထွင်းသိခြင်း။

maggaphalasamādhi.p: [Maggaphala+samādhi] (pu) CL=8 concentration comparable to  Maga, phiula.
a: မဂ္ဂဖလသမာဓိ(ပု)
မဂ်, ဖိုလ်နှင့်ယှဉ်သော သမာဓိ။

B:
maggaphalasamādhi： maggaphalasamādhi（pu）
မဂ္ဂဖလသမာဓိ（ပု）
[maggaphala+samādhi]
[မဂ္ဂဖလ+သမာဓိ]
K:
maggaphalasamādhi：မဂ္ဂဖလသမာဓိ（ပု）
[မဂ္ဂဖလ+သမာဓိ]
မဂ်，ဖိုလ်နှင့်ယှဉ်သော သမာဓိ။

a: မဂ္ဂဖလာဓိဂမ(ပု)
မဂ်, ဖိုလ်ကိုရခြင်း။

B:

[မဂ္ဂဖလ+အဓိဂမ]
K:
maggaphalādhigama：မဂ္ဂဖလာဓိဂမ（ပု）
[မဂ္ဂဖလ+အဓိဂမ]
မဂ်，ဖိုလ်ကိုရခြင်း။
R:
maggaphalādhigama：မဂ္ဂဖလာဓိဂမ （ပ） （မဂ္ဂဖလ+အဓိဂမ）
မဂ်ဖိုလ်ကို ရခြင်း။

maggappaṭipanna.p: [Magga+paṭipanna] (pu) CL=8 (1) attained/reached to Mag: (2) Traveling to the way.(Ti) Maggapaṭipannasabhāga -see. (3) who is travelled on the way; he. (4) who taking the belief of (Brahmans).
a: မဂ္ဂပ္ပဋိပန္န(ပု)

B:
maggappaṭipanna： maggappaṭipanna（pu）
မဂ္ဂပ္ပဋိပန္န（ပု）
[magga+paṭipanna]
[မဂ္ဂ+ပဋိပန္န]
K:
maggappaṭipanna：မဂ္ဂပ္ပဋိပန္န（ပု）
[မဂ္ဂ+ပဋိပန္န]
（၁） မဂ်သို့-ရောက်ခြင်း-ထည့်သွင်းခြင်း။ （၂） ခရီး-လမ်း-သို့သွားခြင်း။ （တိ） မဂ္ဂပဋိပန္နသဘာဂ-ကြည့်။ （၃） ခရီး-လမ်း-သို့သွားသော၊ သူ။ （၄） （ပုဏ္ဏားတို့၏） လမ်းစဉ်သို့ လိုက်သော၊ သူ။
R:
maggappaṭipanna：မဂ္ဂ-ပ္ပဋိပန္န （တိ）
ခရီးသွားသည်။

maggappaṭipanna：မဂ္ဂ-ပ္ပဋိပန္န （ပ）
လမ်းခရီးကို သွားသော သူ။

maggasammādiṭṭhi.p: [Magga+sammādiṭṭhi] (thī) CL=8 right concentration associated with Mag. Magga nāṇna - See also.
a: မဂ္ဂသမ္မာဒိဋ္ဌိ(ထီ)
[မဂ္ဂ+သမ္မာဒိဋ္ဌိ]
မဂ်နှင့်ယှဉ်သော သမ္မာဒိဋ္ဌိ။ မဂ္ဂဥာဏ-လည်းကြည့်။

B:
maggasammādiṭṭhi： maggasammādiṭṭhi（thī）
မဂ္ဂသမ္မာဒိဋ္ဌိ（ထီ）
[magga+sammādiṭṭhi]
[မဂ္ဂ+သမ္မာဒိဋ္ဌိ]

maggasammādiṭṭhi：မဂ္ဂသမ္မာဒိဋ္ဌိ（ထီ）
[မဂ္ဂ+သမ္မာဒိဋ္ဌိ]
မဂ်နှင့်ယှဉ်သော သမ္မာဒိဋ္ဌိ။ မဂ္ဂဉာဏ-လည်းကြည့်။

maggasampadā.p: [Magga+sampadā] (thī) CL=8 perfection of Mag (or) with fulfill mag.

maggasampadā： maggasampadā（thī）
မဂ္ဂသမ္ပဒါ（ထီ）

K:
maggasampadā：မဂ္ဂသမ္ပဒါ（ထီ）

မဂ်နှင့်-မဂ်၌-ယှဉ်သော။

B:
maggasampayutta： maggasampayutta（ti）
မဂ္ဂသမ္ပယုတ္တ（တိ）
[magga+sampayutta]
[မဂ္ဂ+သမ္ပယုတ္တ]
K:
maggasampayutta：မဂ္ဂသမ္ပယုတ္တ（တိ）
[မဂ္ဂ+သမ္ပယုတ္တ]
မဂ်နှင့်-မဂ်၌-ယှဉ်သော။

maggasamādhi.p: [Magga+samādhi] (pu) CL=8 Integrity(concentration) in comparison with Mag. Mag Magsamādhi.
a: မဂ္ဂသမာဓိ(ပု)
မဂ်-နှင့်ယှဉ်၌ရှိ-သောသမာဓိ၊ မဂ်သမာဓိ။

B:
maggasamādhi： maggasamādhi（pu）
မဂ္ဂသမာဓိ（ပု）
[magga+samādhi]
[မဂ္ဂ+သမာဓိ]
K:
maggasamādhi：မဂ္ဂသမာဓိ（ပု）
[မဂ္ဂ+သမာဓိ]
မဂ်-နှင့်ယှဉ်၌ရှိ-သောသမာဓိ၊ မဂ်သမာဓိ။

maggavagga.p:
[Magga+vagga] (pu) CL=8 Magga vaga, dhammapada pāḷi, the twentith of Vaga.
(Vaga means set (or) consonants of the alphabet grouped according to their point of articulation).
a: မဂ္ဂဝဂ္ဂ(ပု)
မဂ္ဂဝဂ်၊ ဓမ္မပဒပါဠိ၊ ၂ဝ-ခုမြောက်ဝဂ်။
ဓမ္မပဒပါဠိ 20

B:
maggavagga： maggavagga（pu）
မဂ္ဂဝဂ္ဂ（ပု）
[magga+vagga]
[မဂ္ဂ+ဝဂ္ဂ]
K:
maggavagga：မဂ္ဂဝဂ္ဂ（ပု）
[မဂ္ဂ+ဝဂ္ဂ]
မဂ္ဂဝဂ်၊ ဓမ္မပဒပါဠိ၊ ၂ဝ-ခုမြောက်ဝဂ်။

maggavaṇṇa.p: [Magga+vaṇṇa] (pu) CL=8 the aesthetic quality of the way,  The pleasure of the way(journey).
a: မဂ္ဂဝဏ္ဏ(ပု)

B:
maggavaṇṇa： maggavaṇṇa（pu）
မဂ္ဂဝဏ္ဏ（ပု）
[magga+vaṇṇa]
[မဂ္ဂ+ဝဏ္ဏ]
K:
maggavaṇṇa：မဂ္ဂဝဏ္ဏ（ပု）
[မဂ္ဂ+ဝဏ္ဏ]
လမ်းခရီး၏ ဂုဏ်ကျေးဇူး၊ လမ်းခရီး၏ သာယာပုံ။
R:
maggavaṇṇa：မဂ္ဂ-ဝဏ္ဏ （ပ）
လမ်းခရီးကို ချီးမွမ်းခြင်း။

maggavijjā.p: [Magga+vijjā] (thī) CL=8 Wisdom compared to Mag; Mag Wisdom/knowlegde.
a: မဂ္ဂဝိဇ္ဇာ(ထီ)
မဂ်၌ယှဉ်သော ဝိဇ္ဇာဉာဏ်၊ မဂ်ဝိဇ္ဇာဉာဏ်။

B:
maggavijjā： maggavijjā（thī）
မဂ္ဂဝိဇ္ဇာ（ထီ）
[magga+vijjā]
[မဂ္ဂ+ဝိဇ္ဇာ]
K:
maggavijjā：မဂ္ဂဝိဇ္ဇာ（ထီ）
[မဂ္ဂ+ဝိဇ္ဇာ]
မဂ်၌ယှဉ်သော ဝိဇ္ဇာဉာဏ်၊ မဂ်ဝိဇ္ဇာဉာဏ်။

maggayamāna.p: [Magga+ṇaya+māna] (ti) CL=8 who is searching  it;  he.
a: မဂ္ဂယမာန(တိ)

B:
maggayamāna： maggayamāna（ti）
မဂ္ဂယမာန（တိ）
[magga+ṇaya+māna]
[မဂ္ဂ+ဏယ+မာန]
K:
maggayamāna：မဂ္ဂယမာန（တိ）
[မဂ္ဂ+ဏယ+မာန]
ရှာမှီး-ရှာဖွေ-သော၊ သူ။

maggayati.p: [Magga+ṇaya+ti] (kri) CL=8 Nīti,dhā.286.] (1) Searching it. (2) Wanted/desires, longing it.
a: မဂ္ဂယတိ(ကြိ)

B:
maggayati： maggayati（kri）
မဂ္ဂယတိ（ကြိ）
[magga+ṇaya+ti．nīti，dhā．286．]
[မဂ္ဂ+ဏယ+တိ။ နီတိ၊ဓာ။၂၈၆။]
K:

[မဂ္ဂ+ဏယ+တိ။ နီတိ၊ဓာ။၂၈၆။]
（၁） ရှာမှီး၏။ （၂） အလိုရှိ၏၊ တောင့်တ၏။
R:
maggayati：မဂ္ဂယတိ （√မဂ္ဂ်）
ရှာဖွေ၏။

a: မဂ္ဂိကပုရိသ(ပု)

K:
maggikapurisa：မဂ္ဂိကပုရိသ（ပု）
[မဂ္ဂိ+ကပုရိသ]
ခရီးသွားယောက်ကျား။

a: မဂ္ဂါမဂ္ဂ(ပု)
(၁)အရိယာမဂ် ဟုတ်သည်, မဟုတ်သည်၊ အရိယာမဂ် ဟုတ်, မဟုတ်သောတရား။(၂)လမ်းစဉ်မှန်, လမ်းစဉ်မှား၊ ကျင့်စဉ်မှန်, ကျင့်စဉ်မှား။

B:
maggāmagga： maggāmagga（pu）
မဂ္ဂါမဂ္ဂ（ပု）
[magga+amagga]
